criteria.text: A series is created once as weekly on one or more chosen weekdays, with an optional start date and an optional end date; the creator never enters individual dates and no other pattern is offered
criteria.note: `post_series`, `page_posts.series_id`, the strict `series` input to `group.post_create` and the composer's Repeat weekly control with weekday chips and two optional dates (#753) [V post.ts, series.ts, AnnouncementFields.tsx]. Off in production: the control shows only with `NEXT_PUBLIC_SERIES_COMPOSER=1` [V AnnouncementFields.tsx:85]; unset [A]. Checked: `[guards F074.1]` whole in `AnnouncementFields.series-whole.test.tsx` (#1070) [V grep]. Reviewed: #753 and #1070 both `review-skipped`. Shipped: green on 685f5d1, ac7377c [V]. Smoked: the flag hides it. #841 is open though #1070 did its work.

criteria.text: Every occurrence is a real page_posts row referencing its parent post, never a date computed at read time
criteria.note: Half built, for loader-managed market Pages only: `syncMarketDays` (#963) writes real dated rows on a `post_series` [V market-days.ts]. A member's series still gets only its first post; reminders (#952) compute dates from weekdays at send time [V post.ts]. #1481 (11-26) trims sample posts, not series [V git show].

criteria.text: Occurrences exist from today to three months ahead, at all times
criteria.note: No job keeps a three-month window for any series; market Pages keep three dates ahead (`MARKET_DAYS_AHEAD`) via `unclaimed-roll` [V].

criteria.text: The job that maintains that window is idempotent: running it twice creates nothing the first run did not
criteria.note: No window job for series; `syncMarketDays` is idempotent but is the market loader's, and there is no (series, start) uniqueness key [V].

criteria.text: An occurrence's start is computed in the metro's timezone, not by adding a fixed number of hours; a weekly series keeps its local time across a daylight-saving change
criteria.note: The DST-aware arithmetic exists (`metroWallTimeToInstant`, #952's `seriesOccurrences`) on a constant `METRO_TIME_ZONE`; nothing expands a member's series, and the metro carries no zone of its own in code (#173 open) [V src/lib/metro].

criteria.text: A time-windowed read returns one row per series (its soonest occurrence in the window) and one row per non-recurring post
criteria.note: `browse_feed` (20261031120000_post_kinds.sql) has no distinct and no grouping by series [V grep]. Must land with the expansion.

criteria.text: Editing one occurrence changes that occurrence and no other
criteria.note: `group.post_edit` updates one row in place, but no member-made occurrence rows exist to prove it on [V].

criteria.text: Each occurrence behaves as its own dated post under F072: its own address, its own time-window match, its own responses
criteria.note: Member-made occurrence rows do not exist; market-day rows are ordinary dated posts [V].

criteria.text: A repeating post says so: every occurrence shows its pattern in plain words ("Every Tuesday"), set by the owner's choice of days, and the owner may add their own tags as on any post
criteria.note: New criterion (F074 `## Rulings` 2026-11-25). Half built: owner tags on any post exist (#286, #1180) [V post.ts]. Missing: no card shows a series' pattern; `PagePosts.tsx` reads `seriesId` only to set Remind me's every-time option [V grep].
